title.zh-CN: Figma 远程（OAuth + 白名单，下一版本支持）
title.en: Figma Remote (OAuth + Allowlist, Supported in Next Version)

summary.zh-CN: Figma 官方远程 MCP 服务，需要 OAuth 认证，且仅允许 Figma 官方认可的 MCP 客户端（需申请加入白名单）。DSH rc.1 不支持 MCP OAuth，且不在允许列表中。下一版本将支持 OAuth，届时还需向 Figma 申请白名单资格。
summary.en: Figma's official remote MCP service requiring OAuth and restricting access to Figma-approved MCP clients only (requires applying to join an allowlist). DSH rc.1 does not support MCP OAuth and is not on the approved list. Next version will support OAuth; allowlist approval from Figma will also be needed.

conditions.en: Requires OAuth authorization; supported in Teloa's next version

conditions.zh-CN: 客户端白名单：DSH rc.1 不在 Figma 允许列表，需额外申请白名单资格
conditions.en: Client allowlist: DSH rc.1 is not on Figma's approved list; additional allowlist approval required
